dedupe_keys.name: schema directeur d accessibilite du reseau de transport

description: Schéma directeur d'accessibilité du réseau de transport is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil général de l'Oise. The purpose of the master plan is to ensure compliance with the obligation of accessibility of public transport services and networks at the end of the 10-year period (February 2015) set by the legislator, through the gradual implementation of appropriate measures and constitutes a programming document for the actions adopted by the Oise Department. Coverage: Conseil général de l'Oise. The portal shows the English title as "Transport network accessibility master plan" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Conseil général de l'Oise. Its keywords include handicap, transport, accessibilite, abri-voyageurs, schema, car. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2015-04-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
